This notice is being sent to travelers to explain what you need to know before using the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways.

Traveler Notice for Companion Animal Travel

Travelers should review the current companion travel guidance before departure so each journey is handled with care and without delay. Aurelia Skyways treats companion travel as a shared responsibility, and our aim is dependable service for every traveler and pet.

Please check with the Companion Animal Travel Desk if your plans involve carrier requirements, cabin placement, or any special handling needs. Keep travel documents ready, follow staff directions closely, and make sure your pet is prepared for screening and boarding. <<FACT F001>> This support helps reduce confusion and protects the comfort of travelers and animals alike.

If you are traveling with a companion animal, pack the approved carrier, secure identification, and allow room for calm movement before boarding. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is ready to guide you through the process and help you travel with confidence.
